interpretations: Group standings by `races.name` across all years, using only standings whose `raceId` matches a race. For each name, average its nonmissing `driverStandings.points` and count its distinct nonmissing `driverId` values. Compute the unweighted average of those counts across race names, then retain names with counts strictly above it. Return one unrounded row containing the unweighted average of the retained names’ point averages, the unweighted average of their counts, and the unweighted average of their counts minus the overall average count.
queries:
WITH name_standings AS (
  SELECT
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) AS average_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS average_count
  FROM name_standings
)
SELECT
  AVG(ns.average_points) AS average_points,
  AVG(ns.driver_count) AS average_driver_count,
  AVG(ns.driver_count) - o.average_count AS count_difference
FROM name_standings AS ns
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ns.driver_count > o.average_count
